script_text: Something ancient is whispering through your chart right now — and most people are too distracted to hear it. Here's the shadow: Saturn in your first house opposes Chiron in the seventh, a retrograde karmic pattern around setting boundaries in love that you keep ignoring. North Node in your fourth house is pulling you toward radical domestic healing. Ground yourself in silence before the energy shifts. Comment your sign — I read every single one.
